mLocKeys.keySummary: Swain launches a wave of demonic power forward. It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits. Swain can then choose to pull all rooted champions closer. This ability has a shorter cooldown during Demonic Ascension.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Swain launches a wave of demonic power that returns, detonating on the first enemy hit to deal @SecondaryDamage@ magic damage and Root enemies in the area for @RootDuration@ seconds.

Rooting a champion allows Swain to reactivate this ability to pull all champions Rooted by Nevermove toward him, gaining a Soul Fragment for each.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules><spellName>Nevermove</spellName> temporarily grants vision of rooted champions.</rules>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Pull all champions <status>Rooted</status> by <spellName>Nevermove</spellName> toward him and gain one <font color='#FF3F3F' size='18'>Soul Fragment</font> for each.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Force of Will</titleLeft><mainText>Syndra has a unit ready to throw.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

Nevermove
Swain has brough his enemies to a kneel and can choose to drag them even further below him.Source: @SourceName@

mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Swain collects Soul Fragments from Vision of Empire, Nevermove, and enemy champion deaths. Soul Fragments restore @PassiveHealPercent@ maximum Health and permanently grant Swain @HealthIncrement@ max Health.

Soul Fragments collected: @f1@
Total Health gained: @MaxHealthGained@

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Ravenous</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is airborne, it can take no actions.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Force of Will</titleLeft><mainText>Syndra has a unit ready to throw.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Swain unleashes several bolts of eldritch power that pierce through enemies. Enemies hit take more damage for each bolt they are struck by.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Swain unleashes 5 eldritch bolts, dealing <magicDamage>@InitialDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> plus <magicDamage>@ExtraBoltDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> per bolt past the first (max <magicDamage>@MaxDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>).

mBuff.mDescription:
Demonic AscensionSwain's inner demon is unleashed causing him to drain health from all nearby enemies.

After a short duration, Swain can erupt a devastating nova of soulfire that slows all nearby enemies.Source: @SourceName@

mLocKeys.keySummary: Swain transforms into a demon and drains health from nearby enemy champions, minions, and neutral monsters. Swain can cast Demonflare to decimate and slow nearby enemies with a nova of soulfire. This form is indefinite as long as Swain drains enemy champions.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Swain frees the demon, which deals @DamageCalc@ magic damage and drains @HealingCalc@ Health per second from nearby enemies. His Demonic Energy depletes over time but can be recharged indefinitely by draining enemy Champions and is fully restored on Champion takedowns.

After @DemonflareCastDelay@ seconds and every @DemonflareCooldownTooltip@ seconds thereafter, Swain can cast Demonflare while transformed, which deals @DemonflareDamageTotal@ magic damage and Slows enemies by @DemonflareSlowAmount*100@%, decaying over @DemonflareSlowDuration@s.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Healing is reduced to @MinionMonsterHealReduction*100@% against non-champions.
Depletes @DemonPowerDegen@ Demonic Energy per second. After @AmpTime@ seconds, this increases to @DegenAmpAmount@.
Regenerates @DemonPowerRegen@ Demonic Energy per second while draining from champions.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Swain unleashes a nova of soulfire, dealing <magicDamage>@Spell.SwainR:DemonflareDamageTotal@ magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slowing</status> enemies by @Spell.SwainR:DemonflareSlowAmount*100@%, decaying over @Spell.SwainR:DemonflareSlowDuration@s.

mBuff.mDescription:
Soulburn
Swain is ten steps ahead of you, slowing your every move.Source: @SourceName@
<titleLeft>Soulburn</titleLeft><mainText>Swain is draining health from this unit.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Ravenous Flock</titleLeft><mainText>Swain has collected @f1@ Soul Fragments and has gained @f2@ bonus Health.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Swain opens a demon eye that deals damage and slows enemies. Champions hit are revealed and also grant Swain a Soul Fragment.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Swain opens a demon eye, revealing a location for 1.5 seconds, then deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage and Slows by @Slow*-100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

Champions hit grant Swain a Soul Fragment and are revealed for @RevealDuration@ seconds.
